claim: Sample demo changes stay in a separate browser-storage namespace.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; edit a note; assert only the demo: key exists and every request stays same-origin

claim: Imported archives and edits stay in extension local storage without a hosted request.
where: landing privacy boundary, privacy page, README
test: npm run build:extension && npx playwright test --grep @claim:extension-local-storage
sandbox: fresh packaged extension at options.html?demo=1; choose Start for real, import HTML, edit a note, and assert chrome.storage.local contains the archive with no non-extension request

claim: This site loads no analytics, advertising scripts, or third-party fonts.
sandbox: fresh browser context starting at /demo; visit every public site route and assert every runtime request is same-origin

claim: Dead pages and failed checks stay separate.
sandbox: fresh /demo sample data; select each group and assert its distinct result and reason

claim: Checks start only when you ask.
sandbox: fresh /demo; assert no completion before action, press Run sample check, then assert the completion announcement

test: npm run build:extension && npx playwright test --grep @claim:html-import
sandbox: fresh packaged extension at options.html?demo=1; import a Netscape bookmark fixture; assert visible title, folder, timestamp, record count, and demo-only storage

claim: Finds duplicate URLs after removing common tracking parameters.
test: npm run build:extension && npx playwright test --grep @claim:duplicate-detection
sandbox: fresh packaged extension at options.html?demo=1; import a UTM URL and clean variant; open Duplicates and assert one visible duplicate

where: how it works, demo, extension, and README
sandbox: fresh /demo; edit a bookmark URL, reload, and assert the repaired URL stays in the demo namespace

test: npm run build:extension && npx playwright test --grep @claim:credential-free-checks
sandbox: fresh packaged extension at options.html?demo=1 with a browser cookie; check a local fixture URL and assert the server received no Cookie header

claim: The checker spaces requests apart and honors Retry-After limits.
test: npm run build:extension && npx playwright test --grep @claim:request-spacing
sandbox: fresh packaged extension at options.html?demo=1; check local fixture URLs; assert same-host arrival spacing and that a Retry-After response blocks the next same-host request

claim: Standard HTML export is always free.
where: landing facts, demo toolbar, and README
sandbox: fresh /demo; download kept bookmarks; assert Netscape header and a kept sample record

claim: An $18 one-time license removes the 50-check limit.
where: paid tier, extension license panel, terms, and README
test: npm run build:extension && npx playwright test --grep @claim:paid-license
sandbox: fresh packaged extension at options.html?demo=1 with 51 invalid-URL fixtures; exhaust 50 attempts, prove a retry cannot bypass the cap, mock a valid license verification, and assert every visible record can be checked again

claim: No purchase link is shown while checkout is unavailable.
where: paid tier, extension license panel, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo, then navigate home; assert the paused notice is visible and no checkout link is present
